title: Gaussian Comparison Theorems for High-Dimensional Posterior Inference
summary: We develop a Gaussian comparison theory for posterior inference in non-Gaussian high-dimensional models. The framework allows for model misspecification and does not require the posterior distribution itself to be approximately Gaussian. Working directly with likelihood processes on separable function spaces, we establish explicit nonasymptotic free energy bounds controlled by first two moment discrepancies and local third moments.
